body:
- When you link a note to a calendar event, the picker now shows which calendar each event comes from, handy if you keep a work and a personal one.
- A linked note's pill now names the meeting it belongs to, so you can tell at a glance what it's attached to.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/compare/v0.3.52...v0.3.53

- Yogurt now trusts the same certificates as your computer. On work networks that inspect secure traffic with their own certificate, the first-run model downloads no longer fail (#115).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/compare/v0.3.51...v0.3.52

- Ask is better at "how did it go?" questions. It now reads the meeting's summary and its key moments, gives an honest read of how things went, and keeps follow-up questions on the same meeting instead of wandering off to another one.
- Macs with 24 GB of memory now get a notes model that leaves room for everything else, so writing notes after a long call no longer freezes the Mac.
- Yogurt is now on Homebrew, through our own tap: `brew install --cask frigadehq/yogurt/yogurt` (#12).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/compare/v0.3.50...v0.3.51

- Teams calls get their names back. On Windows, Yogurt now recognises the Leave button even when Teams adds its shortcut to the label (#83), and on a Mac it asks the Teams app for its window contents before looking for the call (#111).
- Every program and library in the Windows app is now signed, so PCs with Code Integrity turned on no longer block the speech engine during setup (#99).
- Adding a calendar by link opens right in Settings, and each linked calendar has its own row.
- The "Stop recording?" card is now the same compact card as the start offer, closes once the recording ends, and no longer shows up while a recording is still starting.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/compare/v0.3.49...v0.3.50

- Google Meet names are tidier: Yogurt no longer mistakes page text such as "reCAPTCHA" and "Upgrade", or messages in the chat panel, for people on the call.
- In Ask, a cited sentence is now a soft highlight. Hover it to see the part of the meeting it came from.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt/compare/v0.3.48...v0.3.49
